p4_roadmap_fields.identity: Sirolimus, mTOR-inhibitor class; no formulation, dose, trough target or schedule is carried.
p4_roadmap_fields.indication_and_transfer: Origin: tuberous sclerosis infants (NOT WWOX EVIDENCE). Bridge to WOREE: not established.
p4_roadmap_fields.novelty_for_woree: Not found in the research for a WWOX-deficient system at this card's depth. The mTOR/autophagy stubs and the blocked paper are an owed read (FT-074; DIS-37 revival trigger).
p4_roadmap_fields.path_and_objective: Declared BENEFICIO_PRECOCE for this card because only the safety record is visible; the pathway rationale belongs to the deep-recovery path (scientist-a's cards), which this card does not enter.
p4_roadmap_fields.sources: R3 note 1.5 (NOT WWOX EVIDENCE): in 21 infants with tuberous sclerosis «All 21 had at least one adverse effect», mainly haematological and metabolic, no grade 4 or 5 and no discontinuation for an adverse effect; in ten neonatal-unit infants all had raised triglycerides; an infant spontaneous-report reporting ratio the authors call hypothesis-generating. The statement that sirolimus hyperlipidaemia is dose-dependent is a literature claim not shown in the infant cohort (R3 note section 5); no dose-response claim is carried here.
p4_roadmap_fields.evidence_pro_contra: Visible: infant adverse-effect record and the monitoring items the authors name. Absent: any benefit signal in WOREE.
p4_roadmap_fields.time_to_access: UNKNOWN. Its own caution binds this card: «A missing hit does not prove that no study exists.» An NCT number proves neither recruitment nor first dosing.
p4_roadmap_fields.paediatrics_and_interactions: A paediatric record exists for this class in another disease; it is not an authorisation for this one and not a suitability statement. Interactions: UNKNOWN.

p4_roadmap_fields.next_measure: Does the blocked WWOX/mTOR paper (full text unread) report a direction of mTOR activity in a WWOX-deficient system?
p4_roadmap_fields.status: ASTENSIONE. Missing datum: a direction of mTOR activity in a WWOX system and any WOREE endpoint.

evaluation_frame.source: repurposing_10h_scientist-d_20261021.md, 'The answer in one page', DESIGN TABLE A and B. INFERENZA built from precedents that are all NOT WWOX EVIDENCE; the blind audit of that note's manifests is queued and had not returned when this card was written.
a_woree_evaluation_would_have_to_measure: a repeated, instrument-matched baseline before any exposure, in a form that can move in a profoundly impaired child (growth-scale or raw-score forms rather than standard scores); the scatter of an untreated interval has never been measured in WOREE
a pharmacodynamic anchor: none exists for any WWOX-directed intervention (CLAIM 046), so engagement of the intended target cannot be shown at all
one prespecified endpoint with a rescue or withdrawal rule written before the observation window opens
survival, reported beside whatever endpoint is chosen
seizures only as a separate, declared family: a countable fraction, a diary or agreed reconstruction rule, and the seizure-free stratum reported apart (it is prognostic, not a treatment effect)
and_could_not_claim: disease modification or developmental benefit: the developmental-delay row of the one WOREE series reporting a response is identical in every column and two of the three responders had died
that seizure control protects development (CLAIM 031 forbids counting any symptomatic outcome as disease modification)
benefit from a pharmacodynamic move, a global impression or an own-baseline comparison
any effect smaller than the instrument's own untreated scatter
the word protection: nothing in this corpus has been measured as preserving a function that would otherwise have been lost

must_never: No score, rank, probability or blended index. 'Non-dominated' would be a statement about visible dimensions, never a number.
No dose, route, schedule, course or paediatric suitability. Accessibility of a drug, diet or supplement does not prove paediatric suitability.
A computational prediction is not DATO. No engine was run for this card.
Every adjacent source is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE and is never promoted to WWOX evidence.
A missing hit is not proof of absence.
Symptomatic benefit is not slowing of disease; the word 'protection' is not licensed by any evidence on this card.
Where CLAIM 011 has been narrowed, 'dose-dependent' does not stand.
Nothing here is medical advice; it supports discussion with a treating clinical team and never substitutes for one.
